notes_for_editor: Thin record. Two sources agree on the 1937 CCC build replacing an 1918 tower, and the NHLR registration date matches the brief. No staffing, fire or access sources were found. The Forest Fire Lookout Association Massachusetts chapter Facebook posts describe a 67-foot Aermotor MC-39 and say the 1918 tower moved to Georgetown; I could only see search snippets (the pages would not load), so the 67-foot figure is unresolved against the NHLR's 60 feet and is not in the story. The brief's OpenStreetMap height tag of 18.3 m agrees with 60 feet. Worth checking the FFLA posts or a Bureau source before publishing any height beyond 60 feet.
